name: segmented
title: Segmented control
description: A row of choices where one is picked, with a piece that slides to it.

props.name: options
props.description: The choices, in order. Two to five short words work best.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The choice picked when it first renders. The first one if you leave it out.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new choice whenever it changes.
